slob dpon chen po sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i lugs kyi bla bslu'i glud bsngo bzhugs so/na mo gu ru/nad pa'i bla tshe bslu ba'i glud ni/rin po che'i sa

tei:div.tei:p: slob dpon chen po sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i lugs kyi bla bslu'i glud bsngo bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru/ nad pa'i bla tshe bslu ba'i glud ni/ rin po che'i snod du bla glud che ba dang dkor chas bsham/ logs su glud phran chang bu ril bu sogs mang du bsags/ rten 'brel brtag na mda' dar bla g.yus brgyan pa lung pa dgu'i chu sna'i snod du rgya phor gtsang mar bla lug skye mched dod pa bzhag /de nas sngags pas yi dam bsgom/ zhes 'byung bas skyabs sems dang*/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las phag bdun gyis// drangs pa'i shing rtar pad nyi'i steng*// mam̐ las rang nyid 'od zer can// ser po phyag g.yas mchod sbyin g.yon// mya ngan med pa'i yal ga bsnams// dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// cung zad khro zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams// phyed skyil 'od phung klong na bzhugs// thugs kar nyi steng mam̐ gyi mthar// sngags phreng 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis// 'phags mchod gdon bgegs tshar bcad gyur// oṃ ma rī tsyai mam̐ swā hā/ stong las mi nyung bar bzla/ glud yas rnams sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlab pa'am/ bsdu na nam mkha' mdzod kyis spel te bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐/ 'byung ba chen po rnam lnga ni// skye 'gro sems can kun gyi rten// de nyid la ni rten bcas pa'i// spar sme gza' skar tshes grangs lha// sde brgyad bgegs rigs 'byung po'i tshogs// khyad par 'jig rten skyong ba bcu// btsun mo sras dang sde dpung bcas// stobs chen gzi brjid che ba'i tshogs// re ti mgo yag byis pa'i bdud// li byin ha ra srog gi bdag /'khor dang bcas pa ji snyed kun// rtsa ba gsum gyi bka' byung gis// glud dang gtor ma len pa'i phyir// zhi zhing phan pa'i sems kyis su// da lta nyid du gnas 'dir byon// bshams pa'i glud gtor gser skyems 'di// mang por ting nge 'dzin gyis spel// so sor thob pa sngags kyis byas// phyag rgyas pham rgyal 'thab rtsod med// khyed rnams mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul// khar sang khar gyi nyi ma la// rgyu sbyor mi'u rin chen 'di'i// bla la brkus sam gzhom srid na// bla glud gser skyems 'di bzhes la// bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol// bsdams pa glod la mnan pa thegs// zhi ba chen po'i ngang du bzhugs// bkra shis bde legs mdzad du gsol/

zhes spyir bsngo/ de nas glud phran rnams re re nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis brlab/ na maḥsarba sogs kyis bsngo/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams// sred dang chags dang zhen pa dang*// dran dang bzung dang bsam dang reg /glod dang grol dang zhi bar mdzod/ ces bka' bsgo/ de 'dra lo grangs song mthar/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa lta bu grangs med pa 'phros pas 'khor 'das kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes kyi dwangs bcud thams cad dang*/ khyad par bsgrub bya'i bla tshe chad nyams yar ba thams cad 'od zer thig le āḥnṛ bhrāt+s+mum̐ sogs kyi rnam par rang dbang med par bkug ste sgrub bya la thim pas bla tshe srog dbugs nyams pa sor chud/ gnas pa gong du 'phel/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor stobs rtsal thams cad rgyas par gyur/ yi dam gyi sngags mthar oṃ rdzab rdzab rdzub rdzub bha dra slong slong nṛ khug dzaḥdzaḥ zhes ngag bcad la bzla/ yang thun mtshams su glud gtor ci ltar rigs pa phul/ skabs su dmod pa dang bcas bla lug bskor bas lan gcig min par bla rten gyi phyogs la kha gyus na khug pa'i rtags yin/ mthar/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs// rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa// dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs// sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs pa spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ sogs chos sbyin bya/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis bsgom la zab mdo 'don/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa'i// 'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang*// gang yang sa steng 'khod pa dang*// sa blar rgyu ba gang yin pa// mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su// thams cad tha dad 'gro bar gyis/ sarba bhu ta gatstsha/ sogs kyis mgron rnams gshegs/ nag phyogs sdod srid pas drag sngags kyis mtshams bcad la glud gtor chu bo chen po'i gzhung du bskyal/
bla g.yu sgrub bya'i mgul du gdags la bkra shis bya'o/ zhes yig rnying las 'don bder bris pa dge legs su gyur cig /mkhyen brtse'i bka' 'bum las zhal bshus pa'o//
